summary.headline: Interrogation Concerning a Sick Person
summary.text: Chapter IV examines an astrological interrogation concerning a sick person, giving planetary positions and judging the illness through the Leo ascendant, the Sun and Moon’s strength and motion, and their applications first to Mercury and then Saturn.
